purpose: Contextual overlapping token groups with exact greedy decisions and expansion-stable structural circuits for dLLM JSON infilling
model: Pinned official MDLM OWT, audited F32 CPU port, no dropout, timesteps zero, four Torch threads; model load and one common warmup excluded; every compared decoder runs its own forwards

external.scope: tests/draft2020-12/*.json, all object/array data regardless of schema validity, canonical compact sorted-key ASCII JSON; distinct documents
external.selection: Original hash-selected six development,twelve refinement evaluation,next six fresh confirmations. First18 seen in attempt18; last6 were not timed or run through any model in attempt18. No selection by results.
external.masking: For each size, sample positions uniformly without replacement by Random(seed+int(document_hash[:12],16)+size). Boundary and structure tokens are eligible too.
external.license: MIT, preserve source attribution/license and selected source files

operation.grammar: maintained full JSON byte LL1 grammar, EOS absent, fixed-length infilling
operation.support: Initial full-vocabulary top16 at masked slots, then union with current full-vocabulary top16 at EVERY forward on still-masked slots; fixed rows singleton. No target injection or selection-dependent witness added. Initial infeasibility remains explicit; no arbitrary rescue.
operation.proposals: Full-vocabulary top1 at every masked slot, already included in current union; original full-softmax confidence and same descending order
operation.fallback: First greedy-accepted proposal; if none, least viable original token at first free position, identically specified in every method
operation.semantic_scope: Syntax and preserved original unmasked bytes, not instruction following, schema semantics, reconstructed reference accuracy or learned-model quality

controls.greedy_witness: One compiled forest reused, exact Boolean queries with witness reuse inside each full scan
controls.lex_integer: Full priorities, arbitrary-size integer max-plus on same unpruned forest; separate from original MWPC float objective
controls.greedy_cached_prefix: Competent classical control persists witness between forwards and scans only observable prefix/fallback; no needless queries below threshold
controls.monotone: Classical decremental inside/reachability propagation, only actual commitments persisted, credit antecedent
controls.enumeration: Independent Python JSON recognizer over all original token products, resource refusal above 1000000 combinations; no forest cost charged
controls.sat_cached_prefix: Native Cadical195 SAT on equivalent Tseitin AND/OR plus exactly-one original token choices, cached witness and observable prefix; optional research-only python-sat==1.9.dev15

measurement.order: Rotate method list by (case_index+repetition) mod number_methods; all methods on exactly same initial states
measurement.full_cost: All original full prepared-service decoder costs plus EVERY active-domain update, geometry/forest rebuilding, reservoir construction, activation masks and cleanup. Every method runs actual forwards. Preserve point-fastpath equally.
measurement.environment: Record revision, SHA256 inputs/protocol/token adapter/model/grammar, versions, CPU, load average. No simultaneous heavy task started by this agent. Shared desktop contention remains explicit.
measurement.output: Every status/timeout/failure, entire committed trajectory, final IDs/text and component clocks; full logits stay local, supports/proposal probabilities archived
measurement.selection_only: All nine M34 archived JSON inputs may diagnose queries; never described as full generation evidence
measurement.cases: Same six known development, twelve evaluation refinement and six never-model-tested fresh cases, every mask 4/8/16. Development3, fresh9 rotated repetitions. Confirm CPU and GPU after gate; original failures remain.
measurement.fresh_confirmation: If development gate passes, all six untouched hash-selected documents with nine rotated repetitions and all nineteen methods; strengthen timing-repeat confidence without choosing favorable documents.

success.correctness: No unexplained commitment or token-output divergence in conclusive runs; independent JSON/slot/original-fixed-token checks
success.useful_speed: Context_monotone primary or context_root predeclared secondary: >=20% median wall AND CPU against EVERY completed noncontextual control (including all global-class configurations), favorable sign every repetition. All contextual methods solve the same representation contribution; report their comparisons separately, no algorithm superiority by omission.
success.claims: No universal gain, worldwide priority, EPIC superiority, training improvement or publication acceptance from this protocol; growing-support inputs may produce different outputs than frozen-support attempts, and those regimes do not establish a speed-only comparison
success.fresh: Confirm at least one fresh configuration under exact same criterion, nine rotated repetitions, ALL nineteen configurations and every fresh document/mask. Do not choose documents based on results. Dev choice of primary/secondary is disclosed, never validation on development alone.

candidates.why: Same contextual representation with competent incremental GAC and max-plus parser, strong SAT control. No claimed exclusivity over other solvers using this representation.

representation: Per-state groups of original tokens with equal deterministic lexer transition/output; overlapping memberships across possible incoming states retained explicitly. No original-known-context assumed. Classify only reachable preparation states, count all caches, support updates, fallback minimum original token, and all full forwards.
